bio.text: Chip LaMarca represents District 100 in the Florida House of Representatives. According to the House, LaMarca was elected in 2018 and reelected subsequently.
Before that, LaMarca was a Broward County commissioner for District 4 from 2010 to 2018 and a Lighthouse Point city commissioner from 2005 to 2008.
The House lists LaMarca's residence as Lighthouse Point and an occupation of business owner and consultant. LaMarca was born in Winchester, Massachusetts, and moved to Florida in 1971.
